description: Browse the visa catalogue without a profile. Filter by country, category or whether the route leads to permanent residency. Each row gives the id, name, country, government fee, processing time and PR route, so you can pick ids for the other tools.

country.description: Lowercase destination country code, e.g. 'de', 'ca' or 'uk'. 'gb' also works for the UK.

leads_to_pr.description: True for routes that lead to permanent residency, false for those that do not, e.g. true.

limit.description: Most rows to return, e.g. 20. Default 50.

name: transita_list_visas
title: List visas
